notes.title: 🕹️ Vacoo Steam Next Fest LIVESTREAM/Q&A #2 with DEVS
notes.notes:
🎮💥 Gear up for a unique livestream! We're diving into Garbage City, an action-platformer game where we'll "clean 'em up!" with our trusty vacuum cleaner. Our city, made of trash, is brimming with quirky creatures and puzzling adventures. 🗑️👾🧩

During the stream, we'll showcase captivating gameplay, delve into the city's lore, preview early game assets, and introduce the creative minds behind this fantastic, garbage-filled universe. 🕹️📖🎨👥

From high-action moments to clever puzzles, our broadcast is all about exploration, fun, and surprises. Gear up, it's time to show that in Garbage City, every can is a can-do! 🚀🎉💪
